## Authority And Status

The machine-readable readiness authority is `Ahead-of-the-Storm-ORCHESTRATION/contracts/alert_product_v2/`, especially `README.md`, `canonicalization.md`, `schemas/`, `vectors/`, `v1-conformance/`, and `manifest.json` under that directory. This page routes readers to that authority and summarizes it; schema files win over duplicated prose.

Readiness contracts and verification scaffolding are implemented. Runtime ProductDecision v2, ProductFactSet v2 production, episode/link persistence, V1 adaptation, PresentationProfile rendering, CompositionManifest production, and publication-manifest integration are not implemented. Operational activation remains blocked.

Durable boundaries are recorded in [ADR 0010](adr/0010-separate-semantic-alert-facts-from-presentation.md), [ADR 0011](adr/0011-use-provisional-storm-episode-identity.md), [ADR 0012](adr/0012-use-canonical-content-addressed-alert-artifacts.md), and [ADR 0013](adr/0013-keep-alert-publication-data-minimal.md).

| Evidence | Implemented status | Boundary proved |

The current `TRACK_ID` audit still failed: it remains a display/track value that may be `longStormName`. Raw `stormIdentifier` retention now exists, but historical/provider evidence has not established stability across Forecast Runs or non-reuse. Structural tests do not satisfy the operational identity gate.

## First-Tracer Boundary

The schemas authorize readiness for official-advisory Warning/Alert, native forecast-only Warning, provisional Storm Episode and immutable link contracts, a one-way V1 aggregate boundary, ProductFactSet producer results, one compatibility profile, CompositionManifest, strict artifact references, and privacy classifications. They do not authorize sends, recipients, private contacts, delivery state, persistence, scheduling, new profiles, regional composition, detailed rainfall/surge payloads, or operational approval.

Forecast-only evidence cannot produce Alert. ProductFactSet is produced only for Warning or Alert. Availability and review disposition are independent.

### ProductDecision And Producer Result

`schemas/product-decision-v2.schema.json` requires `schema_id`, `schema_version`, `product_decision_id`, `content_digest`, `episode_id`, `country_office_id`, `forecast_run_id`, `product_type`, `reason_code`, `decision_kind`, `classification_evidence_kind`, `evidence_reference_ids`, `policy_release`, and `evaluated_at`.

The schema permits only these complete `(decision_kind, product_type, reason_code, classification_evidence_kind)` combinations:

| Decision kind | Product type | Reason | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| `classification` | `warning` | `qualifying_forecast_only_threat` | `forecast_only_threat` |
| `classification` | `warning` | `qualifying_threat_with_supported_official_status` | `official_advisory` |
| `classification` | `alert` | `qualifying_threat_with_hurricane_status` | `official_advisory` |
| `classification` | `none` | `no_qualifying_country_threat` | either evidence kind |
| `identity_review` | `manual_review` | `storm_identity_ambiguous` | `forecast_only_threat` |
| `evidence_review` | `manual_review` | `unusable_official_state` | `official_advisory` |
| `evidence_review` | `manual_review` | `incomplete_threat_evidence` or `unsupported_evidence` | either evidence kind |
| `policy_withheld` | `withheld` | `policy_withheld_by_policy` | either evidence kind |

`decision-combination-mismatch.json` proves cross-field combinations fail even when each value is individually allowed. `schemas/product-fact-set-producer-result-v1.schema.json` is a strict union:

| `status` | Required result payload |
|---|---|
| `produced` | `result_id`, `content_digest`, `product_decision_id`, complete `product_fact_set` |
| `no_product` | `result_id`, `content_digest`, `product_decision_id`, `reason=no_product_decision` |
| `review_failure` | `result_id`, `content_digest`, sorted `reason_codes`, sorted `evidence_reference_ids`, `failure_digest`; `product_decision_id` is optional |

No variant permits a partial ProductFactSet.

### ProductFactSet Shape

`schemas/product-fact-set-v2.schema.json` requires these top-level fields:

```text
schema_id, schema_version, fact_set_id, content_digest, producer,
created_at, identity, decision, classification_evidence, threat,
metrics, hazards, source_references, visual_source_references,
review_disposition
```

`adapter` is the only optional top-level field. It contains `adapter_id`, `adapter_release`, and `input_content_digest`. ProductFactSet decisions permit only `warning|alert`; forecast-only ProductFactSet requires `warning` and matching `forecast_only_threat` evidence. Its `identity.provisional_identity` must exactly equal forecast-only evidence after mapping `forecast_provider` to `forecast_producer`; `forecast-provisional-identity-mismatch.json` proves a mismatch fails.

ProductFactSet permits exactly three `(product_type, reason_code, classification_evidence_kind)` projections: `(warning, qualifying_threat_with_supported_official_status, official_advisory)`, `(alert, qualifying_threat_with_hurricane_status, official_advisory)`, and `(warning, qualifying_forecast_only_threat, forecast_only_threat)`. `product-fact-decision-projection-mismatch.json` rejects every other mix independently of the broader ProductDecision v2 contract.

Initial metric codes are `modeled_population_exposure`, `modeled_children_exposure`, `modeled_schools_exposure`, `modeled_health_centers_exposure`, `modeled_shelters_exposure`, `modeled_wash_exposure`, `forecast_conditioned_pin`, and `forecast_conditioned_chin`. Geography is `country_office|country|admin1|admin2`; units are `people|facilities`; aggregation is `cumulative|maximum|expected_value|wind_integrated`. Numeric metric values are non-negative integers. PiN/CHiN are threshold-free, `wind_integrated`, and `forecast_conditioned_need`; other metrics require `threshold_kt` and are `forecast_conditioned_exposure`.

Hazards are exactly three records in canonical order: `rainfall`, `storm_surge`, `wind`. Rainfall and storm surge carry availability/detail only in v1; wind additionally requires thresholds and 144-hour horizon. Exact detail enums and conditional field rules remain schema authority.

### Availability And Review

`schemas/common-v1.schema.json` defines six availability states:

```text
validated, unavailable, unvalidated, incomplete, unsupported, ambiguous
```

Availability describes evidence condition. It does not decide review. `review_disposition` independently uses `no_review` with no reasons or `manual_review_required` with one or more of `unsupported_source`, `ambiguous_evidence`, `identity_conflict`, `incomplete_evidence`, `invalid_provenance`, `unsupported_version`, and `privacy_restriction`. Producer review failure additionally permits `forecast_only_alert_forbidden`.

## Provisional Episode Identity

The forecast submodule now retains raw `storm_identifier` without trimming, case conversion, or name substitution, while preserving current `storm_id`/`TRACK_ID` behavior and separate `long_storm_name`. `TC-ECMWF-Forecast-Pipeline/ecmwf_tc_lineage.py` constructs, but does not persist or hash, the candidate tuple:

```text
(forecast_producer, basin, season, normalized_track_id)
```

Exact values and normalization from `canonicalization.md`:

| Field | Rule |
|---|---|
| `forecast_producer` | Literal `ecmwf-ifs-tc-track`. |
| `basin` | `AL|EP|CP`, supplied explicitly. |
| `season` | Integer 2000 through 9999. |
| `provider_storm_identifier_raw` | Preserved separately and included in StormEpisode semantic content. |
| `normalized_track_id` | Unicode NFKC; reject control characters; trim Unicode edge whitespace; require non-empty ASCII; ASCII uppercase; require `^[A-Z0-9]+(?:-[A-Z0-9]+)*$`. |

Storm name and forecast time are excluded from the candidate key. StormEpisode v2 includes the complete provisional identity and derives `episode2:<hex>` from canonical semantic content. Link v1 uses `episode-link1:<hex>`, immutable evidence references, and idempotent/conflict vectors.

This is implemented readiness scaffolding, not qualified operational identity. Historical ECMWF evidence and/or authoritative provider documentation must still establish cross-run stability and non-reuse before activation.

## Restricted Canonical Subset

The exact authority is `canonicalization.md`, independently mirrored by root `canonical_artifact.py`.

| Concern | Exact rule |
|---|---|
| Object names | Non-empty ASCII; canonical JSON sorts by ASCII byte value. |
| Strings | Already Unicode NFC; provisional track normalization is the explicit NFKC exception and yields ASCII. |
| Numbers | Integers only in `[-9007199254740991, 9007199254740991]`; no floats, NaN, infinity, negative zero, or exponent notation. Decimal quantities and coordinates are schema-constrained strings. |
| Time | Whole-second UTC `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`; no offset, fraction, or leap second. |
| Absence | JSON `null` is forbidden in every V2 canonical document; optional fields are omitted. |
| Encoding | UTF-8, no BOM, insignificant whitespace, or trailing newline; validated equivalent is `json.dumps(..., ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False, separators=(",", ":"), sort_keys=True)`. |
| Semantic sets | Already unique/sorted by the keys in `canonicalization.md`; profile/components/omissions preserve profile order; outputs are HTML then visual assets in profile/ordinal order. |
| Digest | SHA-256 over canonical semantic fields excluding identity and `content_digest`; lowercase `sha256:<hex>`. File checksum binds exact stored bytes separately. |

PresentationProfile excludes only `content_digest` from its digest projection and keeps immutable ID `aots.compatibility.long-product.en.v1`. Review-failure `failure_digest` excludes itself. PublicationManifest uses `publication2:<hex>`. Runtime clocks, storage metadata, and export time never enter semantic identities. `ProductFactSet.created_at` and `CompositionManifest.composed_at` are strict content fields with fixed values in the vectors; no runtime derivation is implemented yet.

The four exact files are `canonical/official-alert-product-fact-set.json`, `canonical/compatibility-profile.json`, `canonical/composition-manifest.json`, and `canonical/publication-manifest.json`. Orchestration and root tests both compare canonicalized full documents byte-for-byte with all four files; digest-only agreement is insufficient.

## Artifact References And Privacy

`schemas/artifact-reference-v1.schema.json` requires `schema_id`, `schema_version`, `artifact_id`, `content_digest`, `role`, `path`, `media_type`, `file_checksum`, `publication_classification`, `producer_id`, and `observed_at`; `referenced_schema_id` and additional timestamps are role-dependent or optional. `source_uri` is not a contract field. Paths follow the restricted safe POSIX-relative rule.

ArtifactReference `producer_id` is closed to `aots-orchestration|aots-portable-reports|ecmwf-ifs-tc-track|nhc|synthetic-conformance-producer`.

| Role | Fixed media type / path where fixed | Classification |
|---|---|---|
| `official_public_advisory`, `official_forecast_advisory` | `application/vnd.aots.official-advisory+json;version=1` | `internal_sensitive` |
| `forecast_track` | `application/vnd.aots.forecast-track+json;version=1` | `internal_sensitive` |
| `country_threat_assessment` | `application/vnd.aots.country-threat-assessment+json;version=1` | `internal_sensitive` |
| `impact_metric` | `application/vnd.aots.impact-metric+json;version=1` | `internal_sensitive` |
| `hazard_availability` | `application/vnd.aots.hazard-availability+json;version=1` | `internal_sensitive` |
| `product_decision` | `application/vnd.aots.product-decision+json;version=2` | `internal_sensitive` |
| `product_fact_set` | `application/vnd.aots.product-fact-set+json;version=2`; `artifacts/alert/product-fact-set.json` or `product-fact-set.json` | `internal_sensitive` |
| `presentation_profile` | `application/vnd.aots.presentation-profile+json;version=1`; `presentation-profile.json` | `public_metadata` |
| `composition_manifest` | `application/vnd.aots.composition-manifest+json;version=1`; `composition-manifest.json` | `public_metadata` |
| `alert_claims` | `application/vnd.aots.alert-claims+json;version=1`; `alert-claims.json` | `internal_audit` |
| `rendered_alert_html` | `text/html;charset=utf-8`; `rendered-alert.html` | `public_output` |
| `alert_visual_asset` | `image/png`; `alert-assets/[a-z0-9.-]+-[0-9]+.png` | `public_output` |

Artifact classifications are exactly `internal_sensitive|internal_audit|public_metadata|public_output|synthetic_public`. Visual source references use `internal_sensitive|partner_restricted`; they have closed role/media/purpose enums in the ProductFactSet schema. ProductFactSet, source evidence, and raw provider identity remain internal. Recipients, contacts, delivery state, facility-point geography, raw geometry, and detailed rainfall/surge metadata are schema-prohibited.

Schemas validate JSON structure and controlled metadata only. They do not inspect HTML or PNG bytes for private content, unsafe embedded data, remote resources, or misleading claims. Runtime content privacy inspection, source licensing, country-office/publication approval, and publication enforcement remain unimplemented and blocking; `validation_status=passed` in a conformance document is not operational approval.

Public CompositionManifest v1 no longer carries `source_reference_ids` in component results or outputs. It binds an opaque ProductFactSet artifact ID/digest but exposes no ProductFactSet path, semantic fields, or source-reference IDs/paths.

## CompositionManifest

The exact fields and nested enums are in `schemas/composition-manifest-v1.schema.json` and `vectors/composition-manifest.json`.

| Field | Exact contract |
|---|---|
| Identity | `schema_id`, `schema_version`, `composition_id=cm1:<hex>`, `content_digest`. |
| Inputs | `product_fact_set` (`artifact_id`, digest, schema), `product_decision` (ID, schema version, `warning|alert`), `presentation_profile` (ID, digest, schema). |
| Renderer/time | `renderer_id` is literal `aots-compatibility-renderer`; `renderer_release` is SemVer-shaped; `composed_at` is a strict timestamp. |
| Components | Exactly 13 profile-order records. `rendered` requires `completed`; `rendered_unavailable` requires `explicit_unavailable|evidence_unavailable`; `omitted` requires `evidence_unavailable|omitted_optional_component|unsupported_optional_visual`. |
| Omissions | Profile-order records containing only `component_id` and `reason_code`; no arbitrary `detail`. Reasons are `omitted_optional_component|evidence_unavailable|unsupported_optional_visual`. |
| Outputs | First record is `rendered_alert_html`, `text/html;charset=utf-8`, exact path `rendered-alert.html`; every trailing record is `alert_visual_asset`, `image/png`, `alert-assets/[a-z0-9.-]+-[0-9]+.png`, sorted by path; classification is `public_output`. |
| Privacy | `policy_id=aots-publication-privacy-v1`, `allowlist_version=1.0.0`, `validation_status=passed`. |

Composition component results are exactly `component_id`, `status`, and `reason`; omissions are exactly `component_id` and `reason_code`; outputs are exactly role, path, media type, file checksum, and `public_output` classification. None carries `source_reference_ids`. Every `omitted` component has exactly one same-component/same-reason omission record; rendered components have none; duplicate/orphan omissions fail. The status/reason, omission consistency, HTML-first order, and visual path order vectors enforce these boundaries.

## PublicationManifest V2

The exact authority is `schemas/publication-manifest-v2.schema.json` and four vectors: `publication-public-safe.json`, `publication-forbidden-field.json`, `publication-invalid-classification.json`, and `publication-unsafe-path.json`.

| Field | Exact contract |
|---|---|
| Identity | `schema_id=urn:aots:schema:publication-manifest:2`, `schema_version=2.0.0`, `publication_id=publication2:<hex>`, `content_digest`. |
| Source/root | `publication_source=snapshot_output_bundles`, safe relative `snapshots_dir`, non-negative `snapshot_count`, `snapshots`. |
| Privacy | `policy_id=aots-publication-privacy-v1`, `allowlist_version=1.0.0`, `validation_status=passed`. |
| Snapshot identity | Opaque `case_id` matching `^case-[0-9a-f]{16}$`, three-letter `country_code`, and whole-second UTC `forecast_time`; no storm display name. |
| Comparison | Only five tuples: `(not_run, integrity_checked, false)`, `(not_run, reproduction_ready, false)`, `(failed, reproduction_ready, false)`, `(passed, provisional_comparison, false)`, `(passed, certifying_comparison, true)`. |
| Composition reference | Exact path `snapshots/<case_id>/composition-manifest.json`, `cm1:<hex>`, content digest, and file checksum only. |
| Public artifacts | Non-empty ordered array under `snapshots/<case_id>/`: first `rendered-alert.html`, followed only by path-sorted `alert-assets/*.png`; role/media/checksum/classification are controlled. |

`snapshots_dir` is literal `snapshots`; every composition/output path must use the exact snapshot's opaque `case_id` as its directory. `publication-comparison-mismatch.json` and `publication-case-path-mismatch.json` reject contradictory comparison semantics and cross-case paths. The strict snapshot allowlist forbids storm display name, recipients, and every undeclared field. PublicationManifest contains no ProductFactSet path/content, raw identity, coordinates, admin/facility detail, source-reference IDs/paths, provider attempts, contacts, or delivery state. Contract/vector/test readiness is implemented. Root runtime generation/loading, HTML/PNG content inspection, source licensing, approval, privacy enforcement, and migration from the current publication manifest remain unimplemented and blocking.

## Vectors And Parity Authority

The manifest covers all 32 V2 vectors. The final seven additions cover ProductFactSet decision projection, CompositionManifest output order, visual path order, omission mismatch, evidence-unavailable omission, PublicationManifest comparison projection, and PublicationManifest case/path mismatch. Four exact canonical full-document byte fixtures remain manifest-bound.

The eight V1 bundles are `v1-official-warning`, `v1-official-hurricane-alert`, `v1-no-product`, `v1-manual-review-identity`, `v1-threshold-boundary`, `v1-incomplete-evidence`, `v1-sparse-facts`, and `v1-invalid-provenance`. Their checksums freeze current V1 functions. `external-compatibility-references.json` independently binds current root Alert Decision and Alert Claim fixtures. Expected alert HTML, prose, screenshots, and V2-generated claims are not independent parity authority.

Runtime compatibility parity remains unimplemented. It will pass only when a future renderer consumes ProductFactSet, preserves the frozen required claims, records optional omissions, and passes schema, canonical identity, privacy, and unknown-version checks without changing V1 expectations.

## Independently Testable Tracer Slices

Each runtime slice starts from a frozen synthetic vector, adds one public contract behavior, and keeps persistence and sending disabled.

| Order | Slice | Required outcome | Focused tests |
|---:|---|---|---|
| 1 | V1 freeze | Regenerate the eight existing V1 vectors byte-for-byte without changing V1 source hashes or expected root claims. | Orchestration contract test; root readiness test. |
| 2 | Canonical artifact compatibility | Producer and root reject null and match all four frozen full-document byte files, IDs, digests, safe paths, and manifest checksums. | Existing Orchestration and root readiness tests. |
| 3 | Raw identity retention | Preserve raw `stormIdentifier` through extraction/transformation while legacy `TRACK_ID` behavior remains unchanged. | Forecast lineage and transformer tests. |
| 4 | Episode and link runtime | Produce deterministic official/provisional episodes; replay links idempotently; reject conflicts without rewriting history. | Proposed `test_storm_episode.py`. |
| 5 | ProductDecision v2 | Produce only the eight schema-authorized decision/evidence/reason combinations; every other cross-field combination fails closed. | Proposed `test_product_decision_v2.py`. |
| 6 | Native ProductFactSet | Produce complete official and forecast-only fact sets using only the three exact decision projections, with exact source references, availability, metrics, hazards, digests, and forecast/provisional identity equality. | Proposed `test_product_fact_set_v2.py`. |
| 7 | V1 adapter | Adapt only supported official V1 Warning/Alert aggregates, preserve immutable V1 references, and return typed review failure for unsupported input. | Proposed `test_product_fact_set_v1_adapter.py`. |
| 8 | Root artifact handshake | Load one checksummed `product_fact_set` role and reject unknown versions, unsafe paths, wrong bytes/media/schema, unresolved references, and privacy violations without reclassifying. | Proposed `test_product_fact_set_contract.py` and snapshot tests. |
| 9 | Compatibility composition | Register the controlled renderer/profile; enforce component options, status/reason pairs, exact omission correspondence, HTML-first/path-sorted outputs, role/media/path coupling, and no source references. | Proposed profile/composition/renderer tests. |
| 10 | Visual source enforcement | Render only declared checksummed visual inputs; generic report keys and expected HTML cannot supply semantic claims. | Proposed visual-source and renderer tests. |
| 11 | Publication privacy | Enforce the five comparison tuples and case-ID-derived paths, then inspect actual HTML/PNG content and enforce licensing/approval in addition to schema metadata checks. | Proposed publication/privacy tests. |
| 12 | Independent parity | Compare compatibility output against frozen V1 Alert Claims and block every semantic, provenance, availability, threshold, privacy, or required-visual mismatch. | Proposed claim-parity tests. |

Slices 1-3 and their readiness tests are implemented. Slices 4-12 remain runtime work. Operational identity activation remains blocked even after slice 4 until historical/provider evidence is approved.
